sahneler.metin: A Boeing 737 failed to climb after take-off in Medan.
It crashed into homes, killing people aboard and on the ground.
Its flaps had not been extended.
Without them, the wing couldn't produce enough lift at that speed.
The take-off warning didn't save them.
The cockpit recording showed casual talk during checks.
Checklist discipline and warning checks were emphasized afterward.

aciklama:
Mandala 091 crashed into a neighbourhood on take-off. The cause: take-off without flaps, missed checklist items and no effective take-off warning.

#shorts #engineering #aviation
